_comment: CANONICAL cross-repo fixtures for LibKey.io article links.
THE LOAD-BEARING CASE is `never embeds a library id`. Third Iron's
library-specific form overrides a reader's own affiliation, so hard-coding one
institution on a site open to the world would hand every visitor the wrong
library's holdings. Every URL here is the universal form.
The other rule with teeth: LibKey accepts only DOIs and PMIDs. ERIC accessions
and NCT ids are not identifiers it knows, and ERIC's API exposes no DOI at all,
so those records must yield null and the UI must render nothing — a link that
dead-ends is worse than no link.

cases.name: a PubMed record links by PMID
PMID is preferred over DOI for a PubMed record
a website-shaped record with no src is still treated as PubMed
an ERIC journal accession is not a LibKey identifier
an ERIC document accession is not a LibKey identifier
a trial registration is not a LibKey identifier
an ERIC record that somehow carries a DOI links by DOI
a DOI arriving as a doi.org URL is reduced to its bare form
a dx.doi.org prefix is stripped too
a record with neither a PMID nor a DOI has no link
a whitespace-only DOI is not a link
